versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked (extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version); pageSpecVersion is machine-checked against the schema's const. repositoryVersion is a documentation-only, hand-maintained marker that nothing checks.

source.name: Teachable marketing site (teachable.com), local personal pixel replica
source.measuredAgainst: the running clone (headless Chromium, 1440 / 1280 / 390); live-site evidence comes from the project's own specs

sourceStack: documentation-only: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind CSS v3 + GSAP/ScrollTrigger + Swiper 11 + react-router 6 (package.json); the original is a Webflow site. Never used for token names, section ids, schema fields or validator logic.

constraints.realCompany: Teachable is a real, live company. This repo describes a local, personal pixel replica built for study. It does not license any of the source's brand, copy or media.
constraints.copy: The homepage of the clone carries real Teachable marketing copy from a page the user saved; the other 17 pages use original stand-in copy written for the clone (not Teachable's wording). This repo stores NEITHER: copy is recorded as budgets (characters, words, rendered lines, list sizes) and as one-way hashes used only to detect reuse.
constraints.assets: public/assets holds real logos (Teachable's own and third-party integration/partner/payment brands) and real photos of real creators. Generated pages may not reproduce or imitate any of them (assets/asset-roles.json, pinned in code).
constraints.forms: The clone's forms do not submit anywhere: the talk-to-sales form prevents submit, the watch-demo unlock is stored in local storage only.
constraints.embeds: Vimeo, onelineplayer and Storylane embeds are third-party and domain-restricted; they error when the clone runs locally (role media.third-party-embed, blocked for generation).
constraints.campaign: The countdown banner is a time-limited Halloween campaign counting down to 31 Oct 2026; it is retrieval-ineligible and optional in every template.
constraints.notCloned: The live site's HubSpot pop-up and cookie/consent banner were intentionally not cloned; they are not modelled here.
constraints.glyphs: Some headings replace one letter (o/e/a/i) with a decorative brand SVG; the real letter stays in the DOM. Modelled as primitive.glyph-letter (asset role illustration.brand-glyph, reference-only).
constraints.placeholderQuote: The enterprise quote band uses a placeholder company logo and a fictional quote in the clone.
constraints.liveEndpoint: One live third-party application form link exists (customer-journey tier note); link.live-endpoint is forbidden in every mode and the reference example replaces it with '#'.
constraints.publishing: Do not publish this repo, the clone or any page derived from it, and do not make any repository holding them public.

delivery: Clone: clean install with the lockfile (npm ci) in the project root; never ship node_modules or dist. This folder: python3 + jsonschema (pip install jsonschema); stdlib otherwise.
